Here is Python code to compute percentage increases for the placeholder dataset and sort ascending.

```python
# filename: compute_em_funds_placeholder.py
import pandas as pd

# Placeholder dataset
data = [
    {
        'Fund Name': 'Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund',
        'Ticker': 'FPADX',
        'NAV May 2019': 10.60,
        'NAV May 2024': 11.85,
        'Transaction Fee': '$0'
    },
    {
        'Fund Name': 'Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund',
        'Ticker': 'FEMKX',
        'NAV May 2019': 24.50,
        'NAV May 2024': 28.30,
        'Transaction Fee': '$0'
    },
    {
        'Fund Name': 'Fidelity Emerging Markets Discovery Fund',
        'Ticker': 'FEDDX',
        'NAV May 2019': 18.40,
        'NAV May 2024': 21.90,
        'Transaction Fee': '$0'
    }
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df['% Increase'] = (df['NAV May 2024'] - df['NAV May 2019']) / df['NAV May 2019'] * 100

result = df.sort_values(by='% Increase', ascending=True)
print('Results sorted by percentage increase (ascending):')
print(result[['Fund Name','Ticker','NAV May 2019','NAV May 2024','% Increase','Transaction Fee']].to_string(index=False))

lowest = result.iloc[0]
print('\nLowest percentage increase:', lowest['Fund Name'], f"({lowest['Ticker']})", f"- {lowest['% Increase']:.2f}%")
```
